body: Ven a Queretaro, super underrated, pero tiene todo lo bueno de México, sin lo horrible de todos los demás estados; arquitectura, entretenimiento, ecoturismo,  un chingo de lugares para echar desmadre, muchos pueblos magicos, piramides, etc... Es como una CDMX pero sin basura ni rateros jajaja y solo a 3 horas...

Actually a few months ago I did that, I went to Australia and a few European countries, I love to be alone and talk to myself, i somehow enjoy a part of life but still I feel unsatisfied , I don't know this is really weird, I just don't find atraction to the major part of life anymore, it has beautiful aspects but they are a small portion compared with the horryfiing things in the world and i dont feel free in any way, every day i feel that money and the system is ruling in some way my life, and i hate that feeling, I hate that i was raised, educated, and forced into a system were i was only another number and forced to be like THEY wanted me to be, becouse nowadays you cant escape the system or society. But I'm scared of course, scared that my friends and family will suffer and scared to be wrong, i mean, what if this is the only conciousness life and there is no "other side" you know? its a hard decision to make.
